name: Log Size Ratio of Blockwise-Addressing
details: The construction has $2^{d+1}$ concepts on a domain of $2^{d+1}+1$ coordinates.
proof: There are $2^d$ functions f_i and $2^d$ functions g_i. The domain consists of z and two blocks of 2^d coordinates, so it has $2^{d+1}+1$ elements. Substitution into $\log(|\mathcal H|-1)/\log(|\mathcal X|+1)$ gives the stated expression.
